http1.interpretation: The baseline closes HTTP/1.0 GET even when keep-alive is requested. The candidate retains Content-Length and successfully serves repeated GET plus redirect on the same verified TLS socket. With this body, a persistent HTTP/1.0 200 header grows from 175 to 201 bytes; the improvement is connection reuse, not smaller individual HTTP/1.0 headers.
